original_algorithm: UNKNOWN; the source announce table names the 3002 arguments but no Top Floor streak milestone

notes.arena_win_streak_milestones: SYSTEM_BROADCAST 3002 fires only when the consecutive Top Floor attack-win streak exactly equals one entry; below the first milestone never announces
notes.streak_reset: an attack loss or forfeit resets the streak to zero; defence results leave it unchanged
notes.arena_top3: SYSTEM_BROADCAST 3003 fires only when an attack win strictly improves the challenger into rank 1, 2 or 3
